# Upstream source

This directory contains the upstream C/C++ source used by HawkABuild's
Android JNI integration. It is a source snapshot from
`ggml-org/whisper.cpp`, commit `d1be6fde11ac6e0407606b4e42fe72d34add8037`.

The Android build uses `ggml/`, `include/`, and `src/`. The upstream MIT
license is preserved in `LICENSE`.
